mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS id, t.customer_id AS customer_id, t.security_id AS security_id, s.symbol AS symbol, e.code AS exchange_code, t.side AS side, t.order_type AS order_type, t.status AS status, t.quantity AS quantity, t.limit_price_usd AS limit_price_usd, t.executed_price_usd AS executed_price_usd, t.cash_delta_usd AS cash_delta_usd, t.reason AS reason, t.created_at AS created_at FROM transactions t JOIN securities s ON s.id = t.security_id JOIN exchanges e ON e.id = s.exchange_id WHERE t.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC
